summary: Iteration 2 follow-up testing on Ocean Freight Tracker. Backend: 10/10 pytest tests pass covering auto-delayed comment for ETD change, vessel name change, first-time ETD no-op, LCL/FCL/second-vessel reminders, ANF exclusion, XLSX+PDF magic bytes, vessel_block stacking with 1st/2nd vessel, and XLSX header styling (D9D9D9 fill, black font, black borders). Frontend: Dashboard renders stat-reminders card + reminders-panel with correct row (reminder-{shipment_id}), LCL 8d-out shipment shown with 'LCL cargo report (10d before ETA)' kind. ClientDetail new-shipment dialog exposes all required testids (ship-cargo-type-select, ship-planned-etd-input, ship-planned-eta-input, ship-second-vessel-input, ship-second-etd-input). track-trace-link-{id} verified for 3 carriers: MSC->msc.com, Maersk->maersk.com/tracking/, Vanguard->track-trace.com fallback. Clipboard receives tracking number and sonner toast displays 'MEDU_UI_001 copied — paste in {carrier}'s tracking field'.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~670 lines; still under 700 but growing. Consider splitting into modules (routers/, services/) before next iteration.
_auto_delayed_comment mutates the updates dict in-place AND returns it — pick one pattern; returning is fine but caller ignores the returned tuple's `appended` list.
ClientDetail.jsx is ~550 lines and has 2 copies of ShipmentForm rendering plus a Textarea for inline comment editing. Consider splitting ShipmentForm/VesselCell/ShipmentTable into separate files.

VesselCell wraps <button> for tracking, but the parent row still has clickable Edit/Trash buttons — no nested-button issue found, but the copy-doc button lacks toast on empty tracking (already guarded in openCarrier).
seed_data_creation: Created transient TEST_UI_Iter2 client + LCL shipment via API during Playwright run; cleaned up after each run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test file /app/backend/tests/test_iter2.py is idempotent — creates a scoped TEST_Iter2_Client per session and deletes it at teardown. Uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env via python-dotenv. Iteration 1 file test file (backend_test.py) may still exist and can be run alongside. The existing 'Flange 2000' client (id 61aa6ac3-3adb-44a7-832b-94799a99faf7) is preserved.
rca of the issue: No unresolved bugs. One flakiness note: first-load of dashboard right after creating data via fetch may occasionally show stale (empty) stats because React useEffect fires before the ingress round-trip settles; adding await for networkidle after goto resolves it. Not a production bug — race window only appears in the automation environment.
